name: AccountMfaSettings
title: Blocks/Account/AccountMfaSettings
summary: Multi-factor authentication across an account. A `PageHeader` with Documentation over a flush `Card` holding a Require MFA `SettingsRow` with a `Switch` (turning it on asks in a `ConfirmDialog` that names who has no second factor yet), a warning `Alert` counting the people who sign in with a password only while MFA is optional, the `view/view-table` controls row (`PropertyFilter` over name, email, MFA status and method, Refresh and Download CSV as `IconButton`s in a `Tooltip`, `CollectionPreferences`) and a paginated `DataTable` of people on one `useCollection`: Name (square `Avatar`, name and email), MFA as `TableCellStatus` (Enabled, Not set up), Method, Set up as `TableCellTime`, and `TableCellActions` with Reset MFA (behind a `ConfirmDialog`, for a lost device) or Send setup reminder; a filter with no match shows a small `EmptyState` with Clear filters. Built from `PageHeader`, `Button`, `Card`, `Item`, `SettingsRow`, `Switch`, `Alert`, `PropertyFilter`, `IconButton`, `Tooltip`, `CollectionPreferences`, `DataTable`, `EmptyState`, `Avatar`, `DropdownMenu`, `ConfirmDialog`; its toasts go through `toast` into the app's one toast region (ToastPlugin, or one Toaster at the app root), never a Toaster in the page body. A page body for ConsoleLayout, rendered in its default slot.

variants.name: Required
variants.summary: MFA required for the account: the Switch on, no password-only warning; people without MFA still listed as Not set up until their next sign-in.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: The first load: the Switch disabled and the table's loading rows.

variants.name: Error
variants.summary: The MFA status did not load: a danger Alert with Retry replaces the table and the Switch is disabled.
